cross_body_ranking.reason: Cross-body coarse ranking is disabled: no coarse metric is validated as the same quantity, method and support as the Earth coarse index. Evidence-only and not_comparable metrics must not be scored against Earth candidates.

limitations: Evidence-only: MEGDR native support is 463.0576672 m/pixel, so each cell contains ~11 native pixels and a 250 m grid would upsample an interpolated product.

MEGDR stores median observed topography and supplies interpolated values where no MOLA shot falls in a bin; the two evidence cells are at Jezero for a paired support comparison with CTX, not a new global grid.
MOLA licence/redistribution terms are not stated in the PDS4 bundle labels.
No cross-body or cross-method ranking is enabled.

method.aggregation: mean and linear p90 of valid Horn slope pixels, and fraction strictly below 5 degrees, over the central 5 km cell
method.elevation_fixture: padded reprojected elevation in metres, committed so the slope and aggregation can be recomputed offline
method.slope_algorithm: Horn 3x3 on the reprojected elevation grid

method_calibration.earth_source: Geomorpho250 (PANGAEA 899135) dtm_slope_merit.dem_m_250m, a published 7.5 arc-second preprocessed slope product; the Earth pipeline never computes a slope derivative in this repository.
method_calibration.measured_on_mars: The Mars pilot computes the same Horn 3x3 + 5 km aggregation twice: once from the 20 m CTX DTM reprojected to a 250 m grid (comparable support) and once from the native 463.0576672 m MOLA MEGDR grid. The observed per-cell deltas are in the MOLA evidence manifest and quantify a support/interpolation effect, not an Earth calibration.
method_calibration.not_measured_against_earth: The Earth coarse pilot consumes a published slope product (PANGAEA 899135, 7.5 arc-second). The source MERIT DEM and the product's preprocessing kernel are not part of the pinned snapshot, so computing an Earth Horn-at-250 m control would require downloading a global DEM, which this issue forbids. The preprocessed-product vs DEM-derivative difference against Earth is therefore unmeasured, and every slope-derived planetary metric is marked evidence_only.
method_calibration.unsupported_reason: The Earth coarse pilot defined only slope mean, slope p90, and flat fraction <5 degrees. Relief/roughness/curvature/geomorphon are not part of that coarse feature set, so no planetary coarse value is emitted for them.

source.notes: PDS4 product label: SignedMSB2, 5632 lines x 11520 samples, unit meter, median observed topography within each 0.0078125-degree bin, with an interpolated value supplied where no MOLA observation falls in the bin. The PDS3 label retained in the bundle gives MAP_SCALE 0.463 km and A_AXIS_RADIUS 3396.0 km. The PDS3 label path is used for GDAL raster I/O because GDAL has a PDS3 driver; the numeric metadata is taken from the PDS4 product label.
source.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / MGS MOLA
source.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR median topography, 128 pixels/degree, 0-44N / 0-90E tile
source.vertical_reference: planetary radius minus the GMM3 (mgm1025) areoid, evaluated to degree and order 50

support_comparison.interpretation: Observed deltas between a 20 m CTX DTM aggregated to 250 m and the native 463.0576672 m MEGDR median grid. Differences combine support, binning, interpolation, vertical registration and mosaic effects; they must not be read as a correction factor or a physical equivalence.
support_comparison.label: same-region support/interpolation comparison, not an Earth calibration
